defects: image identification: locally built images have empty RepoDigests, so the old silent '{{.Id}}' fallback recorded a repository-less sha256 ID that docker_only.IMAGE_RE rejects (stage-1 would have crashed on its first control); the fixed workflow pushes to GHCR and records RepoDigests[0] post-push, regex-gated against IMAGE_RE with a loud failure and no fallback

image availability: the candidates job runs on a separate GitHub runner with --pull never, so neither the freshly built image nor a digest pasted from an earlier dispatch existed there; the fixed workflow pushes the pinned image to GHCR (controls job, packages:write) and the candidates job pulls the exact digest reference (packages:read, ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN) before any evaluation
review_fixes.disclosure: stage-1 approval now also covers one-time creation of a private repo-linked GHCR package holding only the vetted node+prisma evaluation image; no stored credentials (per-run GITHUB_TOKEN, login/logout bracketed)
